title: Construction of high-quality rice ribosome footprint library
author: Xiaoyu Yang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.2ktgcwn
materials: Rice tissue is ground to powder with mortar and pestle in liquid nitrogen. About 1 g of the powder is resuspended in 5 mL of ice-cold polysome extraction buffer (PEB) [100 mM Tris-HCl (pH 8.0), 40 mM KCl, 20 mM MgCl 2 , 2% (V/V) polyoxyethylene (10) tridecyl ether (SIGMA), 0.2% (W/V) deoxycholic acid (SIGMA), 1 mM DTT, 100 μg/mL cycloheximide (SIGMA), and 10 U/mL DNase I (Epicentre)]; the suspension is centrifuged at 5,000 g for 10 min at 4 °C followed by another 10 min centrifugation in a new 15 mL DNase/RNase-free tube at 20,000 g at 4 °C in Avanti J-E high-speed centrifuge (Beckman). RNA concentration and A260 units of the supernatant are measured with Nanodrop 2000 spectrophotometers (Thermo) and then used for polysome profile analysis and isolation of ribosome footprints.

For isolation of ribosome footprints, the RNA concentration of rice polysome extract is first adjusted to 400 ng/ μL , and then 200 μL aliquot is digested with the nuclease (20 U per 40 μg of RNA) provided by the TruSeq Mammalian Ribo Profile Kit (Illumina) for 1.4 h in a dry bath (Thermo) that is set at 25 °C with shaking speed of 600 rpm. This digestion is stopped by adding 15 μL of SUPERase-in (Thermo) to the reaction mixture. The ribosome footprints are isolated immediately by loading the entire digested lysate on equilibrated Illustra MicroSpin S-400 HR columns (GE Healthcare) with 3 mL of PEB, followed by spinning at room temperature (RT) with the speed of 600 rpm for 2 min. After adding 20 μL of 10% (W/V) SDS into the filtrate, RNAs are extracted using Zymo RNA clean and concentrator kits R1017 and R1015 (Zymo Research), respectively, according to the manufacturer’s manuals with some modifications.
Purification of rice ribosome footprint library
Purification of enriched rice ribosome footprint library

steps.title: Polysome profile analysis
steps.instruction: Load 1,000 A260 units of isolated polysomes onto a 15‑60 % (w/v) sucrose gradient prepared in a 13 × 51 mm polypropylene tube using a peristaltic pump, centrifuge in a SW‑55 rotor at 4 °C, 170,000 g for 1.5 h, then fractionate and record absorbance at 254 nm with a gradient fractionator and UA‑6 detector.

steps.title: Purify footprints (R1017 kit)
steps.instruction: Add 2 vol RNA Binding Buffer to the isolated ribosome footprints, mix, add 1 vol 100 % ethanol, mix, transfer to the R1017 column and centrifuge 12,000 g, RT, 30 s; repeat centrifugation with the filtrate, discard filtrate; wash column with 400 µL RNA Wash Buffer, centrifuge 12,000 g, RT, 30 s; add 80 µL DNase I solution (5 µL DNase I + 75 µL Digestion Buffer), incubate RT 15 min; wash with 400 µL RNA Pre Buffer (30 s), then 700 µL RNA Wash Buffer (30 s) and 400 µL RNA Wash Buffer (2 min); elute with 50 µL RNase‑free H₂O, incubate 2 min, centrifuge 16,000 g, RT, 1 min (repeat), store at –80 °C to –65 °C.

steps.title: Purify footprints (R1015 kit)
steps.instruction: Add 2 vol RNA Binding Buffer to the ribosome footprints, mix, add 1 vol 100 % ethanol, mix, transfer to the R1015 column and centrifuge 12,000 g, RT, 30 s; repeat with the filtrate, discard filtrate; wash with 400 µL RNA Pre Buffer (30 s), then 700 µL RNA Wash Buffer (30 s) and 400 µL RNA Wash Buffer (2 min); elute with 26 µL RNase‑free H₂O, incubate 2 min, centrifuge 16,000 g, RT, 1 min (repeat), store at –80 °C to –65 °C.

steps.title: Prepare rRNA depletion beads
steps.instruction: Transfer 225 µL rRNA‑depletion magnetic beads to a 1.5 mL DNase/RNase‑free tube, place on magnetic stand until clear, discard supernatant; add 225 µL RNase‑free H₂O, vortex, magnetic stand, discard supernatant; wash again with 225 µL RNase‑free H₂O, discard supernatant; finally resuspend beads in 65 µL Magnetic Bead Resuspension Solution.

steps.title: Hybridize probes to rRNA
steps.instruction: Prepare the hybridization mixture in a 200 µL DNase/RNase‑free PCR tube according to Table 1, mix, run in a PCR machine at 68 °C for 10 min, briefly centrifuge, then incubate at RT for 5 min.

steps.title: rRNA depletion incubation
steps.instruction: Combine the hybridization mixture with the 65 µL magnetic beads prepared above, mix, incubate at RT for 10 min, place on magnetic stand, transfer the clear supernatant to a new 1.5 mL DNase/RNase‑free tube, keep on ice (stop point) and store at –25 °C to –15 °C overnight or at –80 °C to –65 °C for up to one month.

steps.title: Purify rRNA‑depleted footprints
steps.instruction: Adjust the rRNA‑depleted footprint volume to 100 µL with RNase‑free H₂O, add 200 µL RNA Binding Buffer and 450 µL 100 % ethanol, mix, transfer to an R1015 column, centrifuge 12,000 g, RT, 30 s; repeat with the filtrate, discard filtrate; wash with 400 µL RNA Pre Buffer (30 s), then 700 µL RNA Wash Buffer (30 s) and 400 µL RNA Wash Buffer (2 min); elute with 11 µL RNase‑free H₂O, incubate 2 min, centrifuge 16,000 g, RT, 1 min (repeat).

steps.title: 15% urea PAGE size selection
steps.instruction: Prepare 15 mL of 15 % (w/v) urea‑PAGE (6.3 g urea, 5.625 mL 40 % Acrylamide/Bis, 0.75 mL 10× TBE, 12 µL 10 % APS, 9 µL TEMED). Add 1 µL 6× loading dye to 5 µL control RNAs (28 nt and 30 nt sequences) and 2 µL loading dye to ~10 µL ribosome footprint sample, mix, heat 95 °C 5 min, place on ice. Load samples onto the gel, run, stain with pre‑cooled SYBR Gold at 4 °C for 10 min when bromophenol blue reaches the bottom. Excise gel slices containing control RNAs and 28‑30 nt footprints, transfer to 2 mL DNase/RNase‑free tubes, grind and resuspend in 2 µL 10 % SDS, 40 µL 5 M acetic ammonium, 400 µL RNase‑free H₂O. Rotate 30 rpm at 4 °C overnight. Filter through 0.45 µm Spin‑X, centrifuge 12,000 g, RT, 10 min. Add 2 µL glycogen and 700 µL isopropanol, mix, incubate –25 °C to –15 °C overnight. Centrifuge 16,000 g, 4 °C, 30 min–1 h, wash pellet with 80 % ethanol, air‑dry, resuspend in 8 µL (control) and 20 µL (footprint) RNase‑free H₂O.

steps.title: End repair of footprints
steps.instruction: Prepare the end‑repair reaction in a 200 µL DNase/RNase‑free PCR tube according to Table 2, mix, incubate 37 °C for 1 h. Purify the reaction with an R1015 kit: bring volume to 100 µL with RNase‑free H₂O, add 200 µL RNA Binding Buffer and 450 µL 100 % ethanol, mix, bind to column, centrifuge 12,000 g, RT, 30 s; repeat, discard filtrate; wash with 400 µL RNA Pre Buffer (30 s), then 700 µL RNA Wash Buffer (30 s) and 400 µL RNA Wash Buffer (2 min); elute with 11 µL RNase‑free H₂O, incubate 2 min, centrifuge 16,000 g, RT, 1 min (repeat). Keep the eluate on ice for the next step.

steps.title: 3' adapter ligation
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL TruSeq Ribo Profile 3′ Adapter to the control RNA and to the end‑repaired footprint sample, incubate 65 °C 2 min then hold at 4 °C. Add 3.5 µL Ligation Buffer, 1 µL 100 mM DTT and 1.5 µL TruSeq Ligase, mix, incubate 23 °C for 2 h. Finally add 2 µL TruSeq AR Enzyme, mix, incubate 30 °C for 2 h. Place reactions on ice.

steps.title: Reverse transcription
steps.instruction: To each ligation reaction add 4.5 µL TruSeq RT Reaction Mix, 1.5 µL 100 mM DTT, 1 µL EpiScript RT and 6 µL RNase‑free H₂O, mix, incubate 50 °C for 30 min. Add 1 µL TruSeq Exonuclease, mix, incubate 37 °C 30 min, then 80 °C 15 min, then hold at 4 °C (stop point; store libraries at –20 °C or lower). Add 1 µL TruSeq RNase Mix, mix, incubate 55 °C for 5 min to remove remaining RNA.

steps.title: Purify library (R1015 kit)
steps.instruction: Adjust each library volume to 50 µL with RNase‑free H₂O, add 100 µL RNA Binding Buffer and 150 µL 100 % ethanol, mix, bind to R1015 column, centrifuge 12,000 g, RT, 30 s; repeat, discard filtrates; wash with 400 µL RNA Pre Buffer (30 s), then 700 µL RNA Wash Buffer (30 s) and 400 µL RNA Wash Buffer (2 min); elute with 11 µL RNase‑free H₂O, incubate 2 min, centrifuge 16,000 g, RT, 1 min (repeat). Keep eluates on ice.

steps.title: 10% urea PAGE purification
steps.instruction: Prepare 15 mL of 10 % (w/v) urea‑PAGE (6.3 g urea, 3.75 mL 40 % Acrylamide/Bis, 0.75 mL 10× TBE, 12 µL 10 % APS, 9 µL TEMED). Add 2 µL 6× loading dye to each library (~10 µL), mix, heat 95 °C 5 min, place on ice. Run samples on the gel, stain with pre‑cooled SYBR Gold at 4 °C for 10 min when bromophenol blue reaches the bottom. Excise gel slices containing 70‑90 nt libraries, transfer to 2 mL DNase/RNase‑free tubes, grind and resuspend in 2 µL 10 % SDS, 40 µL 5 M acetic ammonium, 400 µL RNase‑free H₂O. Rotate 30 rpm at 4 °C overnight. Filter through 0.45 µm Spin‑X, centrifuge 12,000 g, RT, 10 min. Add 2 µL glycogen and 700 µL isopropanol, mix, incubate –25 °C to –15 °C overnight. Centrifuge 16,000 g, 4 °C, 30 min–1 h, wash pellet with 80 % ethanol, air‑dry, resuspend in 10 µL nuclease‑free H₂O. Store at –20 °C or lower.

steps.title: Circularization of library
steps.instruction: Prepare the circularization reaction according to Table 3, mix, incubate 60 °C for 2 h, then place on ice.

steps.title: PCR enrichment of library
steps.instruction: Prepare the PCR enrichment mix as described in Table 4, mix, run the following program: 98 °C 30 s; 9–13 cycles of 94 °C 15 s, 55 °C 5 s, 65 °C 10 s; then hold at 4 °C. (Forward and index primer sequences are provided in the original text.)

steps.title: AMPure XP bead cleanup
steps.instruction: Combine each enriched library with 90 µL Agencourt AMPure XP beads in a 1.5 mL tube, mix, place on magnetic stand until clear, discard supernatant. Wash beads twice with 200 µL 70 % ethanol, incubating 5 min at RT between washes, then discard supernatant. Air‑dry beads, resuspend in 16 µL nuclease‑free H₂O, place on magnetic stand, transfer the clear supernatant to a new tube, keep on ice.

steps.title: 8% native PAGE purification
steps.instruction: Prepare 15 mL of 8 % (w/v) native PAGE (3 mL 40 % Acrylamide/Bis, 0.75 mL 10× TBE, 12 µL 10 % APS, 9 µL TEMED). Add 3 µL 6× loading dye to each enriched library (~15 µL), mix, run on the gel, stain with pre‑cooled SYBR Gold at 4 °C for 10 min when bromophenol blue reaches the bottom. Excise gel slices containing 140‑160 nt library, transfer to 2 mL DNase/RNase‑free tubes, grind and resuspend in 400 µL 0.4 N NaCl solution. Rotate 30 rpm at 4 °C overnight. Filter through 0.45 µm Spin‑X, centrifuge 12,000 g, RT, 10 min. Add 2 µL glycogen, 40 µL 3 M NaAc (pH 5.2) and 1 mL 100 % ethanol, mix, incubate –80 °C to –65 °C overnight. Centrifuge 16,000 g, 4 °C, 30 min–1 h, wash pellet with 80 % ethanol, air‑dry, resuspend in nuclease‑free H₂O for sequencing.

description: 1) All solutions, reagents, tips and tubes etc. that are used in this protocol must be DNAase/RNAase-free。 2) Polysome extraction buffer should be used immediately after being prepared and the concentration of each component should be strictly quantified, particularly for deoxycholic acid, of which high concentration could result in precipitation of ions in the buffer and failure of ribosome footprint isolation. 3) For storage, the polysome extracts are better to be kept at -80 ~ -65 °C immediately after being frozen with liquid nitrogen. 4) The fresh polysome extracts are better to be used for profile analysis. 5) The amount of nuclease and digestion time could be influenced by tissue types and thus the optimization should be done sometimes. 6) Do not use UV light to visualize the SYBR Gold-stained PAGE gel. 7) Positive control should be included when the PAGE purification is done for rice ribosome footprints or library construction to facilitate the recovery of the samples with expected size. 8) For the enrichment of library by PCR, the amount of template and cycle number should be optimized and excessive template or PCR cycles have to be avoided.
